A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
in the core antenna complex of PS I, a dimeric chlorophyll is the main antenna pigment.
the long-walking antenna pigments in Photosynthesis are not “normal” antenna chlorophylls, but dimeric chlorophylls.
the long-wavelenth antenna pigments are dimeric, and that they are strongly coupled to P700.
